story.body: You put last night's objection into the scene, struck it, and wrote a shorter line. The messenger still enters onto a blank. You did not write an ending, and you did not write the songs.

title: Struck the bald line and wrote a shorter one

story.body: You noted that Thwaite had reached fourteenthly while you worked the messenger, that the third thing is still unnamed, and that you are well. You stopped before you filled the blank.
